# Gold (XAU/USD) briefing — None SGT

Price is $4195.6, +38.6 (+0.93%) compared with yesterday's close of 4157.0.
Current read: BULLISH. Gold is being pushed UP right now. Because it's +0.93% compared with where it finished yesterday, and in the last hour it's been going down (-0.11%), and today's headlines lean good for gold (2 good vs 0 bad).
Today's range: low $4109.0 to high $4210.9. Price is 85% of the way up that range ($86.6 above the low, $15.3 below the high).
Trading sessions open right now: Tokyo. Next: London opens in 436 minutes.
Measured from the last two days of 1-minute data, gold moves most in these hours (SGT): 21:00 (3.3 pips/min), 20:00 (3.0 pips/min), 13:00 (2.8 pips/min).
Related markets today: US dollar index 102.231 (+0.02%), US 10-year yield 5.244 (+0.25%), Silver 61.048 (+2.73%).
The US dollar is basically flat today, so it is not the thing pushing gold around right now.

Things that do not line up (these are usually the real story):
  - Gold and silver are diverging: silver +2.73% vs gold +0.93%. They normally move together, so this gap is unusual.
  - Gold moved +0.93% while the dollar barely moved (+0.02%). So whatever moved gold today was not the dollar.
